### a)

```{r}

setClass("waldCI", slots = c(
  confidence_level = "numeric",
  mean = "numeric",
  sterr = "numeric",
  lb = "numeric",
  ub = "numeric"
  ))

setValidity("waldCI", function(object) {
  if (object@confidence_level > 1) {
    stop("confidence_level too high")
  }
  if ( length(object@confidence_level) == 1 && object@confidence_level < 0) {
    stop("confidence_level too high")
  }
  if (length(object@sterr) == 1 && object@sterr < 0) {
    stop ("can't have a negative sterr")
  }
  if (length(object@lb) == 1 && length(object@ub) == 1 && object@lb > object@ub) {
    stop("can't have lb greater than ub")
  }
  if (length(object@lb) == 1 && length(object@ub) == 1 && object@lb == Inf) {
    stop("can't have infinite lb")
  }
  if (length(object@lb) == 1 && length(object@ub) == 1 && object@ub == Inf) {
    stop("can't have infinite ub")
  }
  has_mean <- length(object@mean) == 1
  has_sterr <- length(object@sterr) == 1
  has_lb <- length(object@lb) == 1
  has_ub <- length(object@ub) == 1
  
  option_1 <- has_mean & has_sterr
  option_2 <- has_lb & has_ub
  
  
  if (option_1 | option_2) {
    return(TRUE)
  } else {
    stop("needs mean and sterr or lb and ub")
  }
  
})

setMethod("show", "waldCI",
  function(object) {
    cat(object@confidence_level)
    cat("\n")
    cat(object@mean)
    cat(object@sterr)
    return(invisible(object))
  }
)

#confidence level
setGeneric("confidence_level",
           function(x) {
             standardGeneric("confidence_level")
           })

setMethod("confidence_level", "waldCI", function(x) {
  x@confidence_level
})

setGeneric("confidence_level<-", function(x, value) {
  standardGeneric("confidence_level<-")
})

setMethod("confidence_level<-", "waldCI", function(x, value) {
  x@confidence_level <- value
  validObject(x)
  return(x)
})

#lb
setGeneric("lb",
           function(x) {
             standardGeneric("lb")
           })

setMethod("lb", "waldCI", function(x) {
  x@lb
})

setGeneric("lb<-", function(x, value) {
  standardGeneric("lb<-")
})

setMethod("lb<-", "waldCI", function(x, value) {
  x@lb <- value
  validObject(x)
  return(x)
})

#ub
setGeneric("ub",
           function(x) {
             standardGeneric("ub")
           })

setMethod("ub", "waldCI", function(x) {
  x@ub
})

setGeneric("ub<-", function(x, value) {
  standardGeneric("ub<-")
})

setMethod("ub<-", "waldCI", function(x, value) {
  x@ub <- value
  validObject(x)
  return(x)
})

#mean
setGeneric("mean",
           function(x) {
             standardGeneric("mean")
           })

setMethod("mean", "waldCI", function(x) {
  x@mean
})

setGeneric("mean<-", function(x, value) {
  standardGeneric("mean<-")
})

setMethod("mean<-", "waldCI", function(x, value) {
  x@mean <- value
  validObject(x)
  return(x)
})

#sterr
setGeneric("sterr",
           function(x) {
             standardGeneric("sterr")
           })

setMethod("sterr", "waldCI", function(x) {
  x@sterr
})

setGeneric("sterr<-", function(x, value) {
  standardGeneric("sterr<-")
})

setMethod("sterr<-", "waldCI", function(x, value) {
  x@sterr <- value
  validObject(x)
  return(x)
})

setGeneric("contains",
           function(object, value) {
             standardGeneric("contains")
           })

setMethod("contains", "waldCI",
  function(object, value) {
    
  has_mean <- length(object@mean) == 1
  has_sterr <- length(object@sterr) == 1
  has_lb <- length(object@lb) == 1
  has_ub <- length(object@ub) == 1
    
    option_1 <- has_mean & has_sterr
    option_2 <- has_lb & has_ub
    
    if (option_1) {
      lb <- object@mean - (2 * object@sterr)
      ub <- object@mean - (2 * object@sterr)
      return(value > lb & value < ub)
    } else {
      return(value > object@lb & value < object@ub)
    }
  }
)

setGeneric("overlap", function(object_one, object_two) {
  standardGeneric("overlap")
})

setMethod("overlap",
          signature = c(object_one = "waldCI", object_two = "waldCI"),
  function(object_one, object_two) {
    
    has_mean <- length(object_one@mean) == 1
    has_sterr <- length(object_one@sterr) == 1
    has_lb <- length(object_one@lb) == 1
    has_ub <- length(object_one@ub) == 1
    
    option_1 <- has_mean & has_sterr
    option_2 <- has_lb & has_ub
    
    lb_one <- 0
    ub_one <- 0
    
    if (option_1) {
      lb_one <- object_one@mean - (2 * object_one@sterr)
      ub_one <- object_one@mean - (2 * object_one@sterr)
    } else {
      lb_one <- object_one@lb
      ub_one <- object_one@ub
    }
    
    has_mean <- length(object_two@mean) == 1
    has_sterr <- length(object_two@sterr) == 1
    has_lb <- length(object_two@lb) == 1
    has_ub <- length(object_two@ub) == 1
    
    option_1 <- has_mean & has_sterr
    option_2 <- has_lb & has_ub
    
    lb_two <- 0
    ub_two <- 0
    
    if (option_1) {
      lb_two <- object_two@mean - (2 * object_two@sterr)
      ub_two <- object_two@mean - (2 * object_two@sterr)
    } else {
      lb_two <- object_two@lb
      ub_two <- object_two@ub
    }
    
      overlap <- ((lb_one > lb_two & lb_one < ub_two) | (ub_one > lb_two & ub_one < ub_two) | (lb_two > lb_one & lb_two < ub_one) | (ub_two > lb_one & ub_two < ub_one))
  
  return(overlap)
      
  })
  


setMethod("as.numeric",
          signature = c(x = "waldCI"),
  function(x) {
    return(c(x@lb, x@ub))
})


setGeneric("transformCI", function(object, fn) {
  standardGeneric("transformCI")
})

setMethod("transformCI",
          signature = c(object = "waldCI"),
  function(object, fn) {
    return(fn(object))
})
```

c)  

```{r}

result <- tryCatch(
  expr = {
    x <- new("waldCI", confidence_level = 0.9, mean = 2, sterr = -2)
  },
  error = function(e) {
    print(e)
    print("Validated an error occurred for negative standard error.")
  }
)

result <- tryCatch(
  expr = {
    x <- new("waldCI", confidence_level = 0.9, lb = 2, ub = 1)
  },
  error = function(e) {
    print(e)
    print("Validated an error occurred for lb > ub.")
  }
)

result <- tryCatch(
  expr = {
    x <- new("waldCI", confidence_level = 0.9, lb = 2, ub = Inf)
  },
  error = function(e) {
    print(e)
    print("Validated an error occurred for Infinite bounds.")
  }
)

result <- tryCatch(
  expr = {
    x <- new("waldCI", confidence_level = 0.9, lb = 2, ub = 3)
    ub(x) <- 1
  },
  error = function(e) {
    print(e)
    print("Validated an error occurred for invalid setter.")
  }
)

```

```{r}
data_tennis_matches <- fread("tennis-atp-sackmann-data/atp_matches_2019.csv")

data_tennis_matches_final <- data_tennis_matches[round == "F"]

print(length(unique(na.omit(data_tennis_matches_final$winner_name))))

print("There are 41 winners and 67 matches, so yes")

winners <- data_tennis_matches_final[, .N, by = winner_name]

repeats <- winners[count > 1, winner_name]
print(paste("The number of repeat winners is", length(repeats)))

max_winner <- max_winner_row$winner_name
max_winners <- max_winner_row$count

print(paste("The player with the most wins is", max_winner))
print(paste("He has", max_winners))
```

d)  

```{r}
data_tennis_matches <- fread("tennis-atp-sackmann-data/atp_matches_2019.csv")

data_tennis_matches_winner_count <- data_tennis_matches[, .(wins = .N), by = winner_name]
data_tennis_matches_loser_count  <- data_tennis_matches[, .(losses = .N), by = loser_name]

tennis_win_lose_count <- merge(
  data_tennis_matches_winner_count, 
  data_tennis_matches_loser_count, 
  by.x = "winner_name", 
  by.y = "loser_name", 
  all = TRUE
)

tennis_win_lose_count <- tennis_win_lose_count[wins + losses >= 5][, ratio := wins / (wins + losses)][order(-ratio)]

print(head(tennis_win_lose_count, 5))
```

## Exercise 3

a)  

```{r}
data <- read_csv("us-states.csv")

g <- data %>% group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(total_cases = sum(cases, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = total_cases)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Daily Cases Starting in 2020.",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Number of Cases"
    ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(g)

print("We see 4 minor spikes and 1 major spike.")

```

b)  

```{r}
data <- read_csv("us-states.csv")

state_rates <- aggregate(
  cases_avg_per_100k ~ state,
  data = data,
  na.rm = TRUE,
  FUN = sum
)

extremes <- state_rates$state[
  state_rates$cases_avg_per_100k %in%
    range(state_rates$cases_avg_per_100k)
]

trajectory <- data[data$state %in%
                     extremes, ]
trajectory <- trajectory[order(trajectory$date), ]

data$date <- as.Date(data$date)

g <- data[data$state %in%
       extremes, ] |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date,
             y = cases_avg_per_100k,
             color = state)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = paste("Daily case rates: ",
                  paste(extremes, collapse = ", ")),
    x = "Date",
    y = "Cases per 100,000",
    color = "State"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(g)

```

c)  

```{r}

data <- read_csv("us-states.csv",
                 show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date))

first_substantial <- data %>%
  filter(cases_avg_per_100k >= 1) %>%
  group_by(state) %>%
  filter(!(state  %in%
             c("Guam", "District of Columbia"))) %>%
  slice_min(date,
            n = 1,
            with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5)

first_substantial %>%
  select(state,
         date,
         cases_avg_per_100k)

top_5_states <- first_substantial %>%
  pull(state)

g <- data %>%
  filter(state %in%
           top_5_states,
         date >= as.Date("2020-01-01"),
         date <= as.Date("2020-3-31")) %>%
  group_by(state, date) %>%
  summarise(total_cases = sum(cases,
                              na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date,
             y = total_cases,
             color = state,
             group = state)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Daily Cases Starting in 2020",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Number of Cases",
    color = "State"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)

ggplotly(g)
```
